missions.description: One counter-clockwise lap of the arena around the central island, past the obstacles between the car's loop and the target's, to the south-west turn just short of the start. The lap ends there and not on the start line: Nav2's goal checker compares the car with the last pose only, so a last pose on the way out would end the course at once. Poses are in the map frame, which SLAM starts at the car's spawn pose (the scenario's origin).
